verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly describe multi-location/multi-state payroll support, automatic tax calculation and filing, and per-employee state tax configuration during onboarding (gusto-docs-31/48/44/45/52/58/63), directly matching the story of running payroll across states with correct withholdings and filings. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of automated new-state employer registration workflow and no independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-state accuracy beyond first-party docs.
